sentences.en: He is an amateur gardener, but his flowers are beautiful.
sentences.zh: 他只是个业余园丁，但他的花却开得非常漂亮。

sentences.en: The comet was first spotted by amateur astronomer Michael Mattiazzo.
sentences.zh: 这颗彗星是业余天文爱好者迈克尔·马蒂亚佐兹首先发现的。

sentences.en: The association has excluded amateurs ever since its foundation.
sentences.zh: 自协会成立以来，就排除了业余人士。

senses.zh: 业余的, 非职业的 - 外行的 -
业余爱好者 - 外行, 生手
